milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate near the 2x2 dark_oak_trapdoor cluster on the ground and face it to demonstrate they have found it. The trapdoors are at spawn-relative (~2,0,2) to (~3,0,3), so the target is the center of the cluster at (2.5, 0, 2.5). max_distance=5 gives a comfortable detection radius since the trapdoors are small flat blocks on the ground. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the trapdoors, not just passing by.

Uses inventory_has because mining dark_oak_wood drops itself as an item into the player's inventory. The player is provided an iron axe to efficiently break the dark_oak_wood blocks on the cabin walls (at spawn-relative ~5-10, 0-4, ~5-10). CommonSenseAgent confirmed dark_oak_wood drops itself when mined. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks since the mined drop ends up in inventory and dark_oak_wood is not in the starting inventory.
